tasks.label: Deploy Applet to COSMIC Panel
tasks.command: cargo deb && sudo apt install --reinstall ./target/debian/cosmic-applet-moon_*.deb && (pkill -x cosmic-applet-moon || true) && (pkill -x cosmic-panel || true) && sleep 0.5

tasks.label: Build & Reload Flatpak Applet
tasks.command: flatpak-builder --user --install --force-clean flatpak-build flatpak/io.github.gavril_amarant.cosmic-applet-moon.yml && (pkill -f cosmic-applet-moon || true) && (pkill -x cosmic-panel || true) && sleep 0.5 && systemd-run --user --collect cosmic-panel
